title: SASjs Server
tagline: Stored programs in JavaScript and Python
author: 4GL Ltd

restrict-access.message: Restrict this app to the users and groups who should reach it: open the app's **Settings > Access control** and choose "Only allow the following users and groups". The app authenticates users through Cloudron single sign-on, so this is the first of the two gates in front of it - and it is the one that decides who can even attempt to sign in.

create-the-groups.message: Create two groups under **Users > Groups** and assign people to them, because sign-in depends on membership: `sasjs-users` for everyone who should use the app, and `sasjs-admins` for its administrators. A user in neither group is refused at sign-in. Membership of `sasjs-admins` is what makes a SASjs administrator - nobody becomes one simply by signing in first.

restrict-drive-writes.message: The `js` and `py` runtimes execute whatever is uploaded to SASjs Drive, server-side. Grant Drive write access only to trusted authors, and keep the app behind Cloudron access control.
